content.short: TaskOn is a platform that boosts the completion of various Web3 tasks in a decentralized way.
content.description: TaskOn is a Web3 task collaboration platform designed for marketing, community growth, and operations. It enables teams to run campaigns that attract users, reward participation, grow communities, manage allowlists, and coordinate both onchain and offchain actions from one interface. The product is widely used for quests, campaign tracking, and user acquisition workflows that need wallet-aware participation rules. On Mantle, TaskOn fits as a quest and campaign layer for teams that want to activate communities without building custom event infrastructure from scratch.
